## Meeting Purpose

[Sync on product backlog, user feedback, and community engagement strategy.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=40.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**New Strategies Live:** Long Strangle and Iron Condor are live, with Iron Condor needing a date-sync fix.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=126.0)
  - [**UI/UX Improvements:** Added full company names to tables for easier tracking and implemented input validation to prevent user errors.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=356.0)
  - [**User Onboarding:** Voucher code confusion will be fixed with a video guide; new course users show mixed engagement (0–6 trades logged).](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=526.0)
  - [**Community Expansion:** A new Discord server for 1,000+ newsletter subscribers will get a dedicated Mindtreasure channel to centralize support and updates.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=909.0)

## Topics

### Product Backlog & Development

  - [**New Strategies Implemented:**](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=126.0)
      - [Long Strangle](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=126.0)
      - [Iron Condor (WIP: date-sync bug needs fixing)](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=169.0)
  - [**UI/UX Enhancements:**](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=356.0)
      - [**Full Company Names:** Added to tables (e.g., "Microsoft" vs. "MSFT") for easier tracking, especially for high-frequency traders.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=356.0)
      - [**Input Validation:** Prevents users from entering illogical strike prices.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=182.0)
  - [**Calendar Spread Logic:**](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=201.0)
      - [**Decision:** Do not build a generic "Calendar Spread" feature.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=201.0)
      - [**Rationale:** The term describes a date structure, not a strategy. It would be too complex to define which legs to display.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=253.0)
      - [**Path Forward:** Implement calendar spreads as specific, named strategies (e.g., "Calendar Strangle") to keep the UI clear.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=253.0)

### User Feedback & Onboarding

  - [**Voucher Code Confusion:**](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=526.0)
      - [**Problem:** Users are unsure where to enter voucher codes.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=526.0)
      - [**Context:** The current flow gives a 7-day trial, with the code entered at the end.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=526.0)
      - [**Solution:** Markus will create a video guide to clarify the process.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=526.0)
  - [**Symbol Search Issues:**](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=417.0)
      - [**Problem:** Users cannot find certain symbols (e.g., German DAX futures, specific USD pairs).](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=417.0)
      - [**Proposed Solution:** Add a search filter (e.g., `Futures`, `Stocks`) to guide users.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=417.0)
      - [**Status:** Low priority for Adrian due to other project commitments.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=494.0)

### User Engagement & Community Growth

  - [**New User Activity (from Markus's course):**](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=605.0)
      - [**Registrations:** 12 users have signed up in the last 2–3 weeks.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=605.0)
      - [**Activity:** Engagement is mixed.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=758.0)
          - [High: Bernd Hebing (6 trades), Leon Ebner (3 trades)](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=792.0)
          - [Low: Many have logged 0 trades.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=758.0)
      - [**Plan:** Markus will increase in-course promotion to make logging trades a routine.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=840.0)
  - [**New Discord Server:**](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=909.0)
      - [**Launch:** Markus invited 1,000+ newsletter subscribers to a new Discord server.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=909.0)
      - [**Goal:** Create a more direct, interactive channel for community engagement and promotions (e.g., Black Friday).](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=909.0)
      - [**Proposal:** Create a dedicated Mindtreasure channel for direct support and updates.](https://fathom.video/share/Wz5R2P_Za3Gxt5bqaHFPUEayhT5pH1TH?tab=summary&timestamp=909.0)
